card.title: 414th RIFLES
card.text: Destruction: Shuffle 97th RIFLES into your deck. Draw 3 cards and deal 3 damage to your HQ.
card.flavorText: The 414th Rifle Regiment was a unit of the 18th Rifle Division of the Red Army during WWII. The division was formed in 1918 with troops from Arkhangelsk, Belsky and Kotlassky areas. In 1920 the division took part in the invasion of Poland, but was defeated in the Battle of Warsaw that same year. In 1939 the 18th Division participated in the Winter War in Finland, but was encircled near Lemetti and yet again defeated. The division was formed again in 1940 and, as part of the 20th Army, it defended against the invading German forces east of the Dnieper River in 1941, where the division was nearly wiped out and disbanded shortly after. Again in 1941 the division was reformed and fought at the Battle of Moscow, and was afterwards raised to Guards status for its actions, and renamed 11th Guards Rifle Division. In 1943 the division broke through the encirclement of Leningrad and joined the forces of the Leningrad Front. In late September 1944, it was stationed along the Soviet-Finnish border, southwest of Sortavala, and later assigned to the Stavka reserves. As part of the 19th Army's 132nd Rifle Corps, the unit participated in the Svir-Petrozavodsk Offensive. In mid-November 1944, the division and its higher headquarters were reassigned to the 2nd Belorussian Front, contributing to the East Pomeranian Strategic Offensive Operation, notably fighting in Danzig, Poland.
